subject: Business Models
title: Community-Owned Businesses
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Community-Owned Businesses.

hook.text: Green Bay Packers are owned by 360,000 fans. No billionaire owner. The community is the business model.

buildup.text: Community ownership uses cooperatives, shared equity, or crowdfunding to distribute control among members.

discovery.text: REI (co-op), Mondragon (worker-owned), and credit unions all prove that community-owned models can scale.

twist.text: Community-owned businesses grow slower because decisions require consensus. Speed is traded for alignment.

climax.text: As trust in big corporations declines, community ownership gains appeal as an alternative to shareholder capitalism.

punchline.text: 360,000 fan-owners, no billionaire. Community ownership trades speed for trust.

quiz.question: What is the main trade-off in community-owned business models?
options: Slower growth due to consensus-based decisions
